name: iBabs Agendapunt to decidesk AgendaItem
description: Maps an iBabs agendapunt (RIS agenda item) onto decidesk's ORI-aligned AgendaItem schema. itemType is inferred from the iBabs type (bespreekstuk -> discussion, hamerstuk/besluit -> decision, else informational). orderNumber comes from the iBabs volgnummer.

mapping.title: {{ values.titel ?? values.onderwerp ?? values.naam }}
mapping.itemType: {% set t = (values.type ?? '')|lower %}{% if t == 'bespreekstuk' or t == 'discussie' %}discussion{% elseif t == 'hamerstuk' or t == 'besluit' or t == 'besluitstuk' %}decision{% else %}informational{% endif %}
